name: appkit-inspector
description: Inspect live native AppKit interfaces inside Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect native macOS views directly inside Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connect a Debug AppKit application, preview its current UI, click native views, inspect hierarchy and geometry, and send precise visual feedback back to Codex.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my running AppKit app and open the inspector.
Inspect the native view I select and locate its source.
Review this AppKit window for layout and accessibility issues.
